name: agent-troops
description: Every web fetch, web search and shell command that can reach the network waits for Allow or Deny on the agent-troops board (http://127.0.0.1:8123), with leak warnings and an approval log. Without the board running, Claude Code asks as usual.

sensitive_files.title: Sensitive files
sensitive_files.description: Comma-separated file patterns, relative to the project (for example config/*,*.pem,customers/*). Once a session reads a matching file, its web calls and outward commands are refused or flagged. Empty: off.

after_sensitive.title: After a sensitive file is read
after_sensitive.description: block: refuse anything leaving the computer for the rest of that session. ask: show it on the board with a red warning.

mcp_calls.title: Ask for MCP tools too
mcp_calls.description: Send every MCP tool call to the board as well (the board cannot tell an MCP tool that reads from one that sends).
